description: The bar chart illustrates the "Recall@10" metric across four different configurations. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking". The vertical axis represents the metric's value on a linear scale, with a visible range starting from 0.1 up to 0.4 and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1. Horizontal gridlines extend across the chart at the 0.2, 0.3, and 0.4 marks. The chart contains four vertical bars that are not sorted by height, and the entire graphic is displayed with a tilted orientation. The bar for "Ours" is visually emphasized in orange and is the tallest in the chart, reaching an approximate value of 0.37. The remaining three bars are colored blue. Among these, the "- critiquing" bar has an approximate value of 0.34, the "- scoring" bar is the shortest overall at approximately 0.22, and the "- ranking" bar reaches approximately 0.33.
